answer: Each identity must burn scarce inference compute to answer a basalt-hard challenge whose solution path is checked through a prism of independent verifier agents, and the resulting comet-trail attestation is logged against a bonded stake. Because every sybil costs real GPU-seconds plus a slashable bond, forging N identities scales linearly in compute and capital, so the attacker pays the same marginal price as an honest agent while gaining no leverage from cheap account creation.
